id: post-node-certificate
title: "Add a certificate authority to the trust store"
description: "Writes the PEM of the object as a file with the osapi- prefix, such as osapi-internal-ca.crt for internal-ca, in the family's local directory: /usr/local/share/ca-certificates on the Debian family, /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors on RHEL and Fedora. Then it rebuilds the trust store with update-ca-certificates or update-ca-trust. SUSE and Alpine report skipped. A CA that osapi deployed already with the same content does not change and reports changed: false. A file of that name that osapi did not write is refused. macOS reports skipped."

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/certificate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Writes the PEM of the object as a file with the osapi- prefix, such as osapi-internal-ca.crt for internal-ca, in the family's local directory: /usr/local/share/ca-certificates on the Debian family, /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors on RHEL and Fedora. Then it rebuilds the trust store with update-ca-certificates or update-ca-trust. SUSE and Alpine report skipped. A CA that osapi deployed already with the same content does not change and reports changed: false. A file of that name that osapi did not write is refused. macOS reports skipped.
